channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Gold trims a part of intraday gains as Fed hike bets and Iran risks support USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) trims a part of its strong intraday gains to levels beyond the $4,200 mark, though it retains positive bias for the first time in four days.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah declines as MSCI’s warning triggers capital outflows
item.description: USD/IDR rebounds after registering modest losses in the previous trading day, hovering around 17,870 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Asian stock trade lower despite progress in US-Iran peace talks; Japan's Nikkei rallies 2%
item.description: Asian stocks kick off the new week on a downbeat note, though signs of progress in US-Iran pace negotiations eased concerns over a potential escalation in geopolitical tensions and limited deeper losses.

item.title: Australian Dollar remains weak near 0.7000 on Middle East peace doubts
item.description: The AUD/USD pair loses traction to near 0.7005 during the early European trading hours on Monday, pressured by risk-off sentiment. Traders continue to assess the developments surrounding the US-Iran peace deal following fresh threats from US President Donald Trump.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Canadian Dollar hits 14-month lows due to safe-haven demand, lower oil prices
item.description: USD/CAD extends its gains for the fifth successive day, trading around 1.4190 during the Asian hours on Monday. The pair hits a 14-month high of 1.4191 as the US Dollar (USD) receives support from safe-haven demand, which could be attributed to renewed concerns over a US-Iran peace deal.

item.title: Japanese Yen languishes near two-year low vs USD as bears shrug off intervention fears
item.description: The USD/JPY pair attracts fresh buyers at the start of a new week and climbs back above mid-161.00s during the Asian session.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Loses traction to near 1.1450 as bearish trend tests lower Bollinger support
item.description: The EUR/USD pair loses ground to around 1.1465 during the early European session on Monday.

item.title: WTI turns upside down as US-Iran tout progress in peace talks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, trades 1.2% lower near $75.50 during the Asian trading session on Monday.

item.title: Swiss Franc remains subdued nearly seven-month lows
item.description: USD/CHF remains stronger for the fourth consecutive day, trading around 0.8080 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Tests nine-day EMA barrier after rebounding above 185.00
item.description: EUR/JPY extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around 185.20 during the Asian hours on Monday. The currency cross holds a mild bullish bias as price sits above the 50-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA), while being capped immediately by the nine-day EMA.

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds gains near 100.00 due to renewed US-Iran tensions
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, recovers its recent losses from the previous trading day and is hovering around 100.80 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: British Pound fills weekly bearish gap vs USD; upside seems capped amid UK political chaos
item.description: The GBP/USD pair climbs back to the 1.3235 region during the Asian session and fails the weekly bearish gap opening amid a modest US Dollar (USD) downtick, though the upside potential seems limited.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar weakens below 0.5750 as PBOC rates hold, US-Iran talks weigh
item.description: The NZD/USD pair trades in negative territory around 0.5735 during the early Asian session on Monday. The China-proxy New Zealand Dollar (NZD) remains weak following the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) interest rate decision.

item.title: Australian Dollar holds gains against Japanese Yen following PBoC rate decision
item.description: AUD/JPY gains ground after posting minor losses in the previous day, trading around 113.30 during the Asian hours on Monday. The currency cross holds ground as the Australian Dollar (AUD) remains stronger following China’s latest monetary policy update.

item.title: Qatar and Pakistan: High-level committee agrees on roadmap to final deal within 60 days
item.description: The US-Iran peace talks took place on Sunday in Bürgenstock, Switzerland, with delegations from Iran, the United States, Qatar, and Pakistan participating.

item.title: China Finance Ministry says to impose measures on 46 US firms in government procurement
item.description: China Finance Ministry said on Monday that officials to impose measures on 46 US firms in government procurement. The authorities further stated that they will add 10 US entities to export control list.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Extends the range play around 0.7000; bearish bias remains
item.description: The AUD/USD pair extends its sideways consolidative price move for the third consecutive day and trades just above the 0.7000 psychological mark during the Asian session on Monday.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.8150 vs. 6.8130 previous
item.description: On Monday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.8150 compared to last Thursday's fix of 6.8130 and 6.7733 Reuters estimate.

item.title: BoJ’s Himino: Delaying adjustment in monetary easing risks price overshoot
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Deputy Governor Himino said on Monday that delaying adjustment in monetary easing could trigger a significant inflation overshoot. Himino emphasized that oil price pass-through to downstream goods is advancing fairly quickly.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rebounds to near $66.00 amid fading US-Iran talks optimism
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) halts its three-day losing streak, trading around $65.90 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: PBOC holds Loan Prime Rates steady in June: What 3.0% means for Australian Dollar
item.description: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC), China's central bank, announced to leave its Loan Prime Rates (LPRs) unchanged on Monday. The one-year and five-year LPRs were at 3.00% and 3.50%, respectively.

item.title: Canadian Dollar struggles near April 2025 lows vs bullish USD amid Iran uncertainty
item.description: The USD/CAD pair kicks off the new week on a positive note and trades near the 1.4170-1.4175 region during the Asian session, close to its highest level since April 2025, set last Friday.

item.title: Euro declines to near 1.1450 amid concerns over progress for US-Iran peace deal
item.description: The EUR/USD pair drifts lower to around 1.1460 during the early Asian session on Monday. Concerns about progress for the US-Iran peace deal and expectations of higher US interest rates boost a safe-haven currency such as the US Dollar (USD) against the Euro (EUR).

item.title: Japan’s Katayama says ready to respond appropriately to FX moves at any time as needed
item.description: Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Monday that the officials are ready to respond appropriately to the currency moves at any time as needed. Katayama declines to comment on specific exchange levels.

item.title: Gold edges lower to near $4,150 on US–Iran peace uncertainty, hawkish Fed signals
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) trades with mild losses around $4,155 during the early Asian session on Monday. Traders continue to assess the developments surrounding the US-Iran peace talks in Switzerland.

item.title: WTI rises nearly 2% on Strait of Hormuz closure, shaky peace talks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the US oil benchmark – opened Monday’s Asian trading with an over $1 bullish gap, retesting the $78 mark, nearly up 2% in early dealings.

item.title: British Pound declines to near 1.3200 as UK PM Starmer expected to resign
item.description: The GBP/USD pair faces some selling pressure near 1.3210 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday, pressured by UK political uncertainty.

item.title: Japanese Yen struggles near 161.50 amid strained US-Iran peace talks
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) is facing fresh headwinds and looking to resume its downside against the US Dollar (USD) as a new week kicks off in Asia on Monday.

item.title: Australian Dollar softens to near 0.7000 as US-Iran talks stall
item.description: The AUD/USD pair declines to around 0.7005 during the early Asian session on Monday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) weakens against the US Dollar (USD) amid risk-off sentiment. Traders will closely monitor the developments surrounding the US-Iran peace deal.
